iraq-unami-mandate-review-2023.iraq-unami-mandate-review-2023/pooled_so: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour to adopt resolution 2682 (2023), unanimously extending the UNAMI mandate until 31 May 2024 [VOTE, TERM]. The mandate prioritizes advice on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, ensuring full, equal, and meaningful participation of women, civil society, and youth [SUPPORT]. Concurrently, the Council mandated an independent strategic review of UNAMI by 31 March 2024 [REVIEW]. This review must consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, and civil society, with Iraq having expressed prior support [CONSULT]. The assessment scope includes evaluating current threats, the relevance of UNAMI tasks, and recommendations regarding mandate, structure, staffing, and regional cooperation [SCOPE]. Additionally, the Secretary-General is requested to report on UNAMI responsibilities every four months [REPORT]. No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record [VOTE].
iraq-unami-mandate-review-2023.iraq-unami-mandate-review-2023/independe: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour and adopted unanimously Resolution 2682 (2023) [VOTE]. The resolution extended the UNAMI mandate until 31 May 2024 [TERM]. It directed the Special Representative to prioritize inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, ensuring full, equal, and meaningful participation of women, civil society, and youth [SUPPORT]. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI's fulfilment of responsibilities every four months [REPORT]. Additionally, an independent strategic review was mandated to conclude by 31 March 2024 [REVIEW]. This review must consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society, and Kuwait [CONSULT]. Its scope includes assessing current threats, evaluating the mandate, structure, and staffing, and determining ways to support Iraq in strengthening regional cooperation [SCOPE]. Iraq's Government expressed support for the review in a letter dated 18 May 2023 [CONSULT]. No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record [VOTE].
